name: runtime-profile-applicability
goal: Require real profiles for executable units without asking declarative CSS for a nonexistent module call; unreadable and mixed sources remain required.

evidence: The completed whole-history audit asks 32 CSS-only units for module latency and memory. The executable classifier treats every readable file without exports as executable, including CSS. This originated in the earlier mandatory profiling implementation; type-only exclusions do not address styles.

The standardized performance-evidence suite covers type-only exports, unreadable files and unexported scripts, but not declarative stylesheet-only or mixed CSS/code units. Add that applicability matrix while preserving unknown and executable-source requirements.
